result:
The suite is repaired with two local commits, nothing pushed, and the three red `it` tests now pass. I did not run the full suite. I reran the failing tests and the ones the fix touches, 332 passed, and clippy, fmt and pre-push are green. The report is at `docs/briefs/views/qa/qa-task.md.report.md`.

All three failures came from `bbca2268` (v18a), which now lends an own method's parameter that it does not keep.

- **`grammar_lowering::a_par_fold_entry_is_entered_from_another_package`:** a real bug in v18a. `par_fold(..., Total::merge)` names `merge` as a function value, but the scan for such methods only read function bodies. `merge` stayed lent (`other: &Total`) while the generated code passes it by value, so rustc reported a type mismatch.
  - **Fix (`fc2b95da`):** `keeps_named_as_values` in `keeps.nika` now also scans the fold expressions and actions of grammar rules. I re-lowered the std sources twice and the second run changed nothing.
- **`lent_arguments::a_method_argument_is_not_lent`:** the test expected the old behaviour (`text: String`). v18a changes that on purpose (ADR-views-3 D1). The test now expects the lent declaration and `s.measure(&t)` at the call, and is renamed `an_own_methods_argument_it_does_not_keep_is_lent` (`b0cd9ce6`).
- **`result_source::a_view_of_a_parameter_taken_by_value_in_a_method`:** the test expected NK2302 ("takes by value") for a view of a method's `String` parameter. A free function with the same body was never refused, and the method now behaves the same. I rewrote the test, renamed `a_view_of_a_parameter_a_method_does_not_keep_is_the_callers`, to assert that both are accepted. This removes the only test of that NK2302 message, so please confirm the new behaviour is what you want.

I tried to keep the old refusal reachable by naming the method as a function value and by changing the parameter type to `Vec[String]`. Both were still accepted, and so was `keep b: String`.

`Found:` in the report records this with a probe: `impl S { fn get(ref self, b: String) -> ref String { return ref b } }` checks clean.
